title: RegistryObject
description: The universal THIN WRAPPER every item in every registry inherits — a stable database envelope (id + type, with the version label in METADATA, NEVER in the name or id) around a FLEXIBLE, versionable `component` payload. The wrapper is stable so one universal interface + one dashboard work across every registry; the component is free to change shape and version independently, and multiple versions coexist losslessly via `versions`. Version lives in metadata, never in names/ids (repo law). ANTI-FRAGMENTATION single source. serves_truth=false — a registry object is a pointer/score/shape, never a truth claim.

id.description: stable, hash-suffixed id — the version is NEVER in the id

type.description: the registry this object belongs to (e.g. model, provider, prompt, validator, benchmark)

version.description: the CURRENT version label (metadata — e.g. '2026.06' or a content hash). NEVER in the id or name.

schema.description: the wrapper schema NAME — unversioned; schema revisions live in schema_version

schema_version.description: which revision of THIS wrapper schema the object conforms to (metadata, not the name)

component.description: the FLEXIBLE payload — the actual record content; its shape varies by registry + version and may change freely without breaking the stable wrapper

versions.description: lossless version history — multiple component versions coexist; [{version, component, created_at, ...}]

metrics.description: measured metrics (accuracy, latency, determinism, cost…) — evidence, not authority
